title: REACTO 6000 CN 27 official China product page
notes: Current exact mainland-China page identifies the latest-generation REACTO 6000 CN 27 with CF3 frame and fork, Shimano 105 Di2, Novatec R6 wheels, fitted 700x28 tires, six sizes and CNY 23,800 reference. It does not publish a complete-bike weight. The fifth-generation manufacturer technical page supplies the 32 mm maximum separately.
